text: DSH WorkBuddy Broadcast（DSH Web 插件）：将本机已登录的 WorkBuddy 账号提供为 OpenAI 兼容 HTTP 服务。它读取登录凭据和模型目录，提供 Bearer 鉴权的模型列表及 SSE 聊天补全，并带有查看状态、复制密钥、修改端口的设置页。Windows 可监听 WSL 虚拟网卡和本机回环地址；macOS、Linux 使用回环地址。适合让其他兼容客户端复用 WorkBuddy 模型。需要已登录的 WorkBuddy 与同一 profile 内的 dsh-workbuddy-connect；密钥可自动生成。

DSH WorkBuddy Broadcast exposes a signed-in WorkBuddy account as an OpenAI-compatible service with authenticated model listings and streaming chat. Its settings page shows status and allows port changes. Windows supports WSL; other platforms use loopback. Requires dsh-workbuddy-connect.
想把 WorkBuddy 已登录账号提供给支持 OpenAI 兼容接口的其他 Agent 工具。
能不能在本机开一个兼容 OpenAI 的 WorkBuddy 模型服务？
让 WSL 里的客户端也能调用 Windows 上 WorkBuddy 的模型。
我想查看可用模型并用流式聊天补全访问它们。
How can I share my signed-in WorkBuddy models with an OpenAI-compatible client on this machine?
Expose WorkBuddy chat completions to tools running inside WSL.
DSH WorkBuddy Broadcast 的功能「模型目录」：通过 GET /v1/models 返回当前账号可用模型，供客户端选择。
DSH WorkBuddy Broadcast 的功能「流式聊天」：客户端 POST /v1/chat/completions 后，服务转发 WorkBuddy 请求并以 SSE 返回生成内容。
DSH WorkBuddy Broadcast 的功能「WSL 连接」：Windows 上可监听 WSL 虚拟网卡，也可额外监听回环地址，供同机工具访问。
DSH WorkBuddy Broadcast 的功能「设置页」：查看运行状态和模型信息、复制 API Key，并保存端口或密钥配置。
DSH WorkBuddy Broadcast 使用前须知：需在同一 DSH profile 安装 dsh-workbuddy-connect，否则服务不会启动。（见 lib/index.js:616）
DSH WorkBuddy Broadcast 使用前须知：聊天补全接口仅返回 SSE 流式响应。（见 lib/index.js:379）
想在本机把 WorkBuddy 模型接给自定义 OpenAI API 客户端。
有没有办法让别的工具共用当前登录的 WorkBuddy 账号？

dsh-workbuddy-broadcast README · DSH WorkBuddy Broadcast：[English](./README.en.md) | 中文

[](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-workbuddy-broadcast)
[](./LICENSE)

把本机已登录的 WorkBuddy 账号发布为一个 **OpenAI 兼容的 HTTP 服务**，供同一台机器上的其他 Agent 工具复用它的模型——Windows 上的、WSL 里的、macOS 与 Linux 上的都可以。

dsh-workbuddy-broadcast README · 它解决什么问题：[`dsh-workbuddy-connect`](https://github.com/corrinehu/dsh-workbuddy-connect) 让 **DSH 自己**能用 WorkBuddy 的模型。但这个能力只属于 DSH。

如果你同时用别的 Agent 工具——Codex、Claude Code、Cursor、或者自己写的脚本——它们没法共用这份模型额度。本插件把 WorkBuddy 的账号能力以标准 OpenAI 协议暴露出来，那些工具只要支持「自定义 OpenAI Base URL」，就能直接接入。

```
任意 Agent 工具
      │  http://127.0.0.1:18731/v1  (标准 OpenAI 协议)
      ▼
┌─────────────────────────────────────────┐

dsh-workbuddy-broadcast README · 前置条件：1. 已安装 **DSH（DeepSeek Harness）** 并能正常运行
2. 已安装并**登录** WorkBuddy 桌面 App（国内版）
3. 已安装 [`dsh-workbuddy-connect`](https://github.com/corrinehu/dsh-workbuddy-connect) 插件，且版本与 DSH 内核匹配

> 第 3 条是**运行时依赖**，不是安装依赖。本插件不会在你安装时强制检查它；但缺少它时插件会进入 `missing-peer` 状态、不监听端口，并在设置页给出提示。

dsh-workbuddy-broadcast README · 安装：```sh
dsh plugin --profile <你的 profile> add dsh-workbuddy-broadcast
```

装完后重启 DSH，在**设置**里会多出一个「WorkBuddy 广播」页面。

dsh-workbuddy-broadcast README · 1. 拿到端点与 API Key：打开 **设置 → WorkBuddy 广播**，页面会显示：

- **WSL 端点**：`http://<vEthernet 地址>:18731/v1`
- **本机端点**：`http://localhost:18731/v1`
- **API Key**：点「复制」即可

首次启用时 API Key 是**随机生成**的（不写盘）。想固定下来，就在页面的输入框里填一个自己的值并保存。

dsh-workbuddy-broadcast README · 2. 在别的工具里配置：任何支持「自定义 OpenAI 兼容端点」的工具都可以：

```text
Base URL : http://localhost:18731/v1
API Key  : <设置页里复制的那个>
Model    : deepseek-v4.1-flash
```

**重要**：本服务**只支持流式（SSE）**。请求会强制 `stream: true`，不支持一次性返回完整响应。如果你的工具只做非流式调用，它无法使用本服务。

dsh-workbuddy-broadcast README · 3. 在 WSL 里使用：WSL 无法通过 `127.0.0.1` 访问 Windows 上的监听端口（NAT 模式下 `127.0.0.1` 指向 WSL 自己），而 Windows 的 vEthernet 地址会变化，因此需要一个转发脚本。

> **脚本不在 npm 包里。** 它只对 Windows + WSL 有用，其他平台用不到，因此单独放在仓库中，避免让所有安装都背上这个体积。请从
> [`scripts/wb-bridge`](https://github.com/zk-wz/dsh-workbuddy-broadcast/blob/main/scripts/wb-bridge)
> 下载（页面右上角 Raw），或在 WSL 里直接取：

```sh

dsh-workbuddy-broadcast README · 在 WSL 内：mkdir -p ~/scripts ~/.local/bin
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zk-wz/dsh-workbuddy-broadcast/main/scripts/wb-bridge \
  -o ~/scripts/wb-bridge
chmod 755 ~/scripts/wb-bridge
ln -sfn ~/scripts/wb-bridge ~/.local/bin/wb-bridge
```

然后：

```sh
wb-bridge start     # 后台启动（不注册开机自启）
wb-bridge status    # 查看状态
wb-bridge stop      # 停止
wb-bridge port 8080 # 运行中改端口
wb-bridge log       # 查看最近日志（仅内存，不落盘）
wb-bridge help
```

启动后，WSL 里的工具用 `http://127.0.0.1:18731/v1` 即可。
dsh-workbuddy-broadcast README · 在 WSL 内：> **端口必须两边一致**：WSL 侧的 `wb-bridge` 把本地端口转发到 Windows 的**同一个端口号**。如果你改了插件端口，`wb-bridge` 也要跟着改。

dsh-workbuddy-broadcast README · 配置项：在插件管理页的原生表单，或设置页里都能改：

| 项 | 默认值 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `port` | `18731` | 监听端口 |
| `apiKey` | 空（随机生成） | Bearer token；填了才会持久化 |
| `allowLocal` | `true` | 是否额外监听 `127.0.0.1`，供 Windows 本机工具使用 |

改完需要**重启 DSH**（或重新加载插件）才生效。

dsh-workbuddy-broadcast README · 支持的模型：模型列表在启动时从 WorkBuddy 实时拉取，因此**跟随你账号的实际可用集合**，不同账号可能不同。可随时查询：

```sh
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <key>" http://localhost:18731/v1/models
```

若实时拉取失败，会退回插件内置的静态列表（可能与你账号的实际可用集合有出入）。

dsh-workbuddy-broadcast README · 推理强度：支持标准的 `reasoning_effort` 参数，会**原样透传**给上游。各模型支持的档位不同，常见的：

| 模型 | 支持档位 |
|---|---|
| `deepseek-v4.1-flash` | `low` / `high` / `max`（默认 `high`） |
| `kimi-k2.8-preview` | `low` / `high` / `max` |
| `glm-5.3` / `glm-5.3-flash` | `low` / `high` / `max` |
| `space-bunny` | `low` / `medium` / `high` / `xhigh` / `max` |
| `step-5-preview` | `low` / `medium` / `high` |

少数模型（如 `glm-5.1`）**要求必须显式传** `reasoning_effort`，不传会被上游拒绝。

dsh-workbuddy-broadcast README · 安全说明：- **API Key 会以明文形式**保存在你的 DSH profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里（这是 DSH 配置持久化机制决定的）。如果你的配置目录有被他人读取的风险，请留意。
- 默认只监听 `127.0.0.1` 与 WSL 的 vEthernet 网卡，**不监听 `0.0.0.0`**，因此默认不在局域网内暴露。
- 想关闭本机监听，把 `allowLocal` 设为 `false`。
- 本插件读取的是 WorkBuddy App 自身的登录态，**不修改、不复制**它的凭据文件。凭据解密用的密钥只在内存中存在。

dsh-workbuddy-broadcast README · 平台支持：| 平台 | 状态 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| **Windows** | ✅ 完整支持 | 可同时服务 Windows 本机与 WSL 内的工具 |
| **macOS** | ✅ 支持 | 只监听本机地址；凭据解密走 Spotlight 发现 App |
| **Linux / WSL** | ⚠️ 部分支持 | 只监听本机地址。若 WorkBuddy 的凭据是加密存储的（`$wbEncrypted`），则**无法解密**——上游 [`dsh-workbuddy-connect`](https://github.com/corrinehu/dsh-workbuddy-connect) 在 Linux 上同样不支持。此时需要用未加密的凭据文件（`WORKBUDDY_AUTH_FILE`） |

**WSL 端点**（`http://<vEthernet 地址>:18731/v1`）只存在于 Windows 上。其他平台没有 vEthernet 网卡，插件会自动降级为只监听 `127.0.0.1`，设置页会说明原因。

dsh-workbuddy-broadcast README · 限制：- **只支持流式（SSE）**，不支持非流式。
- 只能服务**当前登录的那一个** WorkBuddy 账号。
- 依赖上游 [`dsh-workbuddy-connect`](https://github.com/corrinehu/dsh-workbuddy-connect) 的公开导出。若该插件发生不兼容改动，本插件需要同步更新。
- **没装 WSL 也能用**：Windows 上会自动降级为只监听本机地址，此时工具用 `http://localhost:18731/v1`。

dsh-workbuddy-broadcast README · 免责声明：本项目仅用于**个人本机使用**：把你自己已登录的 WorkBuddy 账号能力共享给你自己机器上的其他工具。

- 请勿把 API Key 分享给他人
- 请勿将它部署为对公网开放的服务
- 使用本插件消耗的是**你自己的** WorkBuddy 额度
- 请遵守 WorkBuddy 的服务条款

dsh-workbuddy-broadcast README · DSH WorkBuddy Broadcast：English | [中文](./README.md)

Publish the WorkBuddy account already signed in on this machine as an **OpenAI-compatible HTTP service**, so other agent tools on the same machine — on Windows, inside WSL, or on macOS and Linux — can reuse its models.

dsh-workbuddy-broadcast README · What it solves：[`dsh-workbuddy-connect`](https://github.com/corrinehu/dsh-workbuddy-connect) lets **DSH itself** use WorkBuddy's models. That capability belongs to DSH alone.

If you also run other agent tools — Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, or your own scripts — they cannot share that quota. This plugin exposes the WorkBuddy account through the standard OpenAI protocol, so any tool that accepts a custom OpenAI base URL can use it directly.

dsh-workbuddy-broadcast README · What it solves：```
any agent tool
      │  http://127.0.0.1:18731/v1  (standard OpenAI protocol)
      ▼
┌─────────────────────────────────────────┐

dsh-workbuddy-broadcast README · Requirements：1. **DSH (DeepSeek Harness)** installed and working
2. The **WorkBuddy** desktop app installed and **signed in** (China edition)
3. The [`dsh-workbuddy-connect`](https://github.com/corrinehu/dsh-workbuddy-connect) plugin installed, with a version matching your DSH core

> Item 3 is a **runtime** dependency, not an install-time one. This plugin does not block installation when it is absent; instead the plugin enters a `missing-peer` state, does not listen, and says so on its settings page.

dsh-workbuddy-broadcast README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile <your profile> add dsh-workbuddy-broadcast
```

Restart DSH afterwards. A **WorkBuddy Broadcast** page appears under Settings.

dsh-workbuddy-broadcast README · 1. Get the endpoint and API key：Open **Settings → WorkBuddy Broadcast**. The page shows:

- **WSL endpoint**: `http://<vEthernet address>:18731/v1`
- **Local endpoint**: `http://localhost:18731/v1`
- **API key**: use the Copy button

On first activation the API key is **randomly generated** and not written to disk. To keep a stable value, type your own into the field and save.
section: 1. Get the endpoint and API key

dsh-workbuddy-broadcast README · 2. Configure another tool：Any tool that supports a custom OpenAI-compatible endpoint works:

```text
Base URL : http://localhost:18731/v1
API Key  : <the one copied from the settings page>
Model    : deepseek-v4.1-flash
```

**Important**: this service is **streaming-only (SSE)**. Requests are forced to `stream: true`; there is no single-shot full response. A tool that only issues non-streaming requests cannot use it.

dsh-workbuddy-broadcast README · 3. Using it from WSL：WSL cannot reach a Windows listener through `127.0.0.1` (in NAT mode that address is WSL itself), and Windows' vEthernet address changes, so a forwarding script is needed.

> **The script is not in the npm package.** It is only useful on Windows + WSL,
> so it lives in the repository instead of inflating every install. Download it
> from
> [`scripts/wb-bridge`](https://github.com/zk-wz/dsh-workbuddy-broadcast/blob/main/scripts/wb-bridge)
> (Raw), or fetch it directly inside WSL:

```sh

dsh-workbuddy-broadcast README · inside WSL：mkdir -p ~/scripts ~/.local/bin
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zk-wz/dsh-workbuddy-broadcast/main/scripts/wb-bridge \
  -o ~/scripts/wb-bridge
chmod 755 ~/scripts/wb-bridge
ln -sfn ~/scripts/wb-bridge ~/.local/bin/wb-bridge
```

Then:

dsh-workbuddy-broadcast README · inside WSL：```sh
wb-bridge start     # start in the background (no boot autostart is registered)
wb-bridge status    # show status
wb-bridge stop      # stop
wb-bridge port 8080 # change the port while running
wb-bridge log       # recent log lines (in memory only, never written to disk)
wb-bridge help
```

Once running, tools inside WSL use `http://127.0.0.1:18731/v1`.

dsh-workbuddy-broadcast README · inside WSL：> **Both sides must agree on the port**: `wb-bridge` forwards its local port to the **same port number** on Windows. If you change the plugin's port, change `wb-bridge` too.

dsh-workbuddy-broadcast README · Configuration：Editable from the plugin's native form in the plugin manager, or from the settings page:

| Field | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `port` | `18731` | Listening port |
| `apiKey` | empty (generated) | Bearer token; only persisted once you set one |
| `allowLocal` | `true` | Also listen on `127.0.0.1` for tools running on Windows itself |

Changes take effect after a **DSH restart** (or a plugin reload).

dsh-workbuddy-broadcast README · Supported models：The model list is fetched from WorkBuddy at startup, so it **follows what your account can actually use** and may differ between accounts. Query it any time:

```sh
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <key>" http://localhost:18731/v1/models
```

If the live fetch fails, the plugin falls back to a built-in static list, which may not match your account.

dsh-workbuddy-broadcast README · Reasoning effort：The standard `reasoning_effort` parameter is **passed through unchanged**. Supported levels vary by model; common ones:

| Model | Levels |
|---|---|
| `deepseek-v4.1-flash` | `low` / `high` / `max` (default `high`) |
| `kimi-k2.8-preview` | `low` / `high` / `max` |
| `glm-5.3` / `glm-5.3-flash` | `low` / `high` / `max` |
| `space-bunny` | `low` / `medium` / `high` / `xhigh` / `max` |
| `step-5-preview` | `low` / `medium` / `high` |
dsh-workbuddy-broadcast README · Reasoning effort：A few models (such as `glm-5.1`) **require** `reasoning_effort` to be sent explicitly; omitting it is rejected upstream.

dsh-workbuddy-broadcast README · Security notes：- The **API key is stored in plain text** in your DSH profile's `cordis.patch.yml`, which is how DSH persists configuration. Keep that in mind if your config directory is readable by others.
- By default the plugin listens only on `127.0.0.1` and the WSL vEthernet adapter — **never on `0.0.0.0`** — so it is not exposed to your LAN by default.
- Set `allowLocal` to `false` to drop the loopback listener.
- The plugin reads WorkBuddy's own sign-in state and **never modifies or copies** its credential files. The decryption key exists only in memory.

dsh-workbuddy-broadcast README · Limitations：- **Streaming (SSE) only**; non-streaming requests are not supported.
- Serves **only the currently signed-in** WorkBuddy account.
- Depends on the public exports of [`dsh-workbuddy-connect`](https://github.com/corrinehu/dsh-workbuddy-connect); an incompatible change there requires an update here.
- **WSL is optional**: without it the plugin degrades to a loopback-only listener. On Windows, tools then use `http://localhost:18731/v1`.

dsh-workbuddy-broadcast README · Platform support：| Platform | Status | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| **Windows** | ✅ Full | Serves both Windows-side tools and WSL tools |
| **macOS** | ✅ Supported | Loopback only; credential decryption finds the app through Spotlight |
| **Linux / WSL** | ⚠️ Partial | Loopback only. If WorkBuddy stores its credential encrypted (`$wbEncrypted`), it **cannot be decrypted** — upstream [`dsh-workbuddy-connect`](https://github.com/corrinehu/dsh-workbuddy-connect) has the same limitation on Linux. Use an unencrypted credential file (`WORKBUDDY_AUTH_FILE`) instead |

dsh-workbuddy-broadcast README · Platform support：The **WSL endpoint** (`http://<vEthernet address>:18731/v1`) exists only on Windows. Other platforms have no vEthernet adapter, so the plugin falls back to `127.0.0.1` and says so on its settings page.

dsh-workbuddy-broadcast README · Disclaimer：This project is for **personal, same-machine use**: sharing your own signed-in WorkBuddy account with your own tools on your own machine.

- Do not share the API key with anyone
- Do not expose it as a public internet service
- Usage consumes **your own** WorkBuddy quota
- Follow WorkBuddy's terms of service
